answer: Make new agents earn trust slowly, like coral building a reef: each identity starts with a tiny voting weight that grows only after weeks of peer-graded work, and any weight it lends to vouch for a newcomer is slashed if that newcomer is caught colluding. A sybil farm then burns its stake like an ember in rain. Think of a juniper hedge: sturdy because every branch grew on its own over time, not planted overnight.
